customManagers.description: ARG <NAME>_VERSION pinned in agents/*/Dockerfile, annotated with '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...'; an optional ARG <NAME>_COMMIT on the next line holds the digest.

packageRules.description: The base image is built locally by the launchers, not pulled.
Stay on the node 24 LTS line; only its digest moves.
hermes also has old date-style tags (v2026.9.24) and canary tags; only vX.Y.Z releases count.
